scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && npm --prefix packages/models run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-web-vendors.mjs && node scripts/verify-web-assets.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/models run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs packages/models/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.harness:server:init: npm run build && node dist/entrypoints/harness-server-main.js init
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && node scripts/build-desktop-native.mjs && node scripts/desktop-run.mjs
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run build && node scripts/build-desktop-native.mjs && node scripts/desktop-run.mjs --smoke
